methodology_other:
Dataset: Downloaded from the [National Statistics Office of Malawi](http://www.nsomalawi.mw/) 2008 files.  Topology and P-codes cleaned by OCHA.

Final processing and quality control performed by ITOS.
name: cod-ab-mwi
notes:
Malawi administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 3 nan  
- Admin 2: 32 nan  
- Admin 3: 433 nan  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 04 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 05 April 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 22 October 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 22 October 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
